rapport_notes: Polite and professional with a non-committal price-shopper; not much warmth built beyond courtesy, but no pressure applied either.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: that includes the taxes and truck and insurance that does cover $2,000 worth of, I know, damage coverage for any kind of incidentals as well

top_strength: Handled a price-comparison shopper gracefully without being pushy, keeping the door open for a return call ('give us a shout back').
coaching_note: No agenda question and only one of three differentiators was covered — On-Time Guarantee and Meet Your Mover were both skipped, missing two trust-building levers on exactly the kind of call where they matter most (a comparison shopper).
